<style id="fb-clickable-hover-fix">
      button:not(:disabled), [role="button"]:not([aria-disabled="true"]), a[href], label[for], select { cursor: pointer; }
      button:not(:disabled), [role="button"]:not([aria-disabled="true"]) { transition: filter .15s ease, transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; }
      @media (hover: hover) {
        button:not(:disabled):hover, [role="button"]:not([aria-disabled="true"]):hover { filter: brightness(.97); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.10); }
      }
      button:disabled, [aria-disabled="true"] { cursor: not-allowed; }
    </style>
</head>
